summary: Iteration 6: Superadmin phone-change feature validated end-to-end. All 11 new backend tests pass (negative security cases, normalization, audit log, factory-reset keeper follow-current, seed idempotency across restart, RBAC blocking admin/lender, restore). Regression: test_pinjamku_flow.py + test_iter2_features.py + test_iter4_rbac_regress.py — 74 tests all pass (85 total incl. iter6 minus 11 = 74 legacy). Frontend: superadmin sees profile-phone-input, conditional password field appears, empty-password shows toast (no logout), correct-password saves, login with new phone works. Admin does NOT see phone input; no 'Failed to fetch' overlay. Superadmin phone restored to 081200000001 and password intact.

integration_issues.flow: Profile - Superadmin phone change with WRONG current_password
integration_issues.issue: Global axios 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js clears pk_token and hard-redirects to /login whenever ANY /api call returns 401. When user submits phone change with a wrong current_password, backend correctly returns 401 with detail message, but frontend interceptor logs the user out instead of showing the inline error toast on /profile. UX regression only for this specific self-service flow — the actual client-side empty-password guard works fine (no request sent).

action_items: Consider making the axios 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js skip auto-logout for PUT /auth/profile and PUT /auth/password (re-auth failures), so a wrong current_password on the phone-change form shows a toast without kicking the superadmin out. Alternative: return 400 (not 401) from backend for wrong current_password on those endpoints, since the JWT itself is still valid.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.update_profile correctly re-auths superadmin, validates format 0xxxxxxxxx, checks uniqueness, and audits both LOGIN_PHONE_CHANGED (with old_value/new_value.phone) and PROFILE_UPDATED.
server.seed_superadmin is now guarded by 'any superadmin exists' check — no longer overwrites password nor creates a duplicate on restart. Verified across a real supervisorctl restart.
admin_routes._primary_superadmin falls back to earliest-created superadmin when SUPERADMIN_PHONE no longer matches — factory-reset keeper follows the current admin.
Profile.jsx conditional password field is guarded by phoneChanged and only rendered for superadmin. Non-superadmin roles never see profile-phone-input.

success_rate.frontend: 100% happy path; 1 UX issue on wrong-password 401 auto-logout

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test admin/lender accounts (081277776666, 081299990099, 081299990002) — all deleted at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter6_phone_change.py includes a supervisorctl restart of backend and verifies seed idempotency. Superadmin phone is restored to 081200000001 by test_zz_restore_super_phone (sorted-last by name). If interrupted mid-run, ensure users with phone 081288887777/081299990001 are cleaned and superadmin phone matches SUPERADMIN_PHONE in backend/.env.
rca of the issue: Frontend wrong-password auto-logout: axios response interceptor treats every 401 as session expiry. On PUT /auth/profile with wrong current_password, backend legitimately returns 401 for the re-auth check, and the interceptor removes pk_token and redirects to /login. Mitigation: relax interceptor for re-auth endpoints OR use HTTP 400 in backend for re-auth failure specifically.
